LanguageData.LP_PotionHealing.label: healing potion
LanguageData.LP_PotionHealing.description: The potion's power flows between the wounds, greatly raising natural healing speed.
LanguageData.LP_PotionHealing.stages.1.label: doubled
LanguageData.LP_PotionGiantStrength.label: giant strength
LanguageData.LP_PotionGiantStrength.description: The might of lava fills the limbs.
LanguageData.LP_PotionFireResistance.label: fire resistance
LanguageData.LP_PotionFireResistance.description: The skin is covered in an invisible coolness that fire can barely harm.
LanguageData.LP_PotionInvisibility.label: potion of invisibility
LanguageData.LP_PotionInvisibility.description: The body fades; enemies can't see this person. Attacking reveals them at once and the potion's effect ends.
LanguageData.LP_PotionHeroism.label: heroism
LanguageData.LP_PotionHeroism.description: Fearless courage surges in the chest: no mental breaks, and can't be frightened.
LanguageData.LP_PotionMindShield.label: mind shield
LanguageData.LP_PotionMindShield.description: A mist-like barrier shrouds the thoughts. Mind resistance +40% (adds to racial resistance, up to 95%).
LanguageData.LP_TrollRegenTonic.label: troll regenerant
LanguageData.LP_TrollRegenTonic.description: Troll blood writhes inside: wounds slowly heal while food is at least 50% (a quarter of a troll's rate); doesn't regrow limbs or revive. Pauses while on fire, burned or acid-burned. Hunger rate ×1.5. When it wears off there's a 10% chance of troll blood addiction.
LanguageData.LP_TrollBurned.label: burned
LanguageData.LP_TrollBurned.description: The troll was burned by fire, and its flesh regeneration is interrupted for 6 hours; dying during this time it won't revive.
LanguageData.LP_TrollAcid.label: acid-burned
LanguageData.LP_TrollAcid.description: The troll was burned by acid, and its flesh regeneration is interrupted for 6 hours; dying during this time it won't revive.
LanguageData.LP_RecentlyBled.label: recently drawn
LanguageData.LP_RecentlyBled.description: This troll just had blood drawn; you have to wait for the wound and blood level to recover before drawing again.
LanguageData.LP_TrollBloodAddiction.label: troll blood addiction
LanguageData.LP_TrollBloodAddiction.description: The body has grown used to the regeneration troll blood brings and can't do without it. Without regular troll regenerant, withdrawal sets in; going a long time without it can slowly break the habit.
LanguageData.LP_TrollBloodAddiction.stages.1.label: withdrawal
